The *Tika Saraṇaduka* (Patthana 4.8) is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Within the combinatorial system of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it treats the causal relations according to the synthesis of triplets (*tika*) and the dyad on defilement or war (*saraṇaduka*).
